biography: Christopher 'Chrissy' Wright, a name whispered with a mix of awe and exasperation in the Caterham paddock, hails from a small village in the Cotswolds. His racing journey began, not in karting, but on the treacherous, muddy trails of his family's farm, tearing around on a beat-up quad bike he nicknamed 'The Red Baroness.' This unorthodox training instilled in him a raw, instinctive car control rarely seen in drivers his age. His transition to Caterham racing was meteoric. Spotted at a local hill climb by a Caterham talent scout, Wright was immediately signed. A defining moment came at Oulton Park in 2022, where, starting from the back of the grid after a mechanical failure, he carved his way through the field to snatch victory on the final corner. Currently, Wright is seen as a rising star, but his inconsistency and tendency to overdrive the car often overshadow his brilliance. He is, as many would say, a rough diamond needing some serious polishing.
drivingStyle: Wright's driving style is best described as 'seat-of-the-pants.' He attacks every corner with a ferocious commitment, often pushing the car beyond its limits. He favors late braking and aggressive turn-in, relying on his exceptional car control to recover from potential oversteer. Tire management is not his strong suit; he tends to burn through rubber in the early stages of a race. However, when under pressure, Wright displays remarkable composure, often finding an extra gear when it matters most. He's a showman, often prioritizing spectacle over pure efficiency.

rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities and driving styles. Moreau, known for her precise and calculated approach, often clashes with Wright's aggressive and unpredictable maneuvers.
Thornton accuses Wright of blocking tactics and dangerous driving after a controversial incident at Brands Hatch in 2023.
A rivalry born from consistently fighting for the same podium positions. Silva and Wright are close on pace, and their races are always nail-bitingly close.

quirks: Always wears a pair of lucky red socks, gifted by his grandmother, under his race suit.
Listens to classical music (loudly) on his headphones right up until the minute he gets into the car.
Has a pre-race ritual of drawing a small cartoon version of 'The Red Baroness' on his steering wheel with a dry-erase marker.
famousQuote: "If you're not on the edge, you're taking up too much space!"
careerHighlight: Winning the Caterham Supersport Championship at Silverstone in 2023 after a season-long battle, securing the title in the final race with a daring overtake on the last lap.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at Donington Park in 2022 due to over-exuberance, costing him valuable championship points and drawing criticism from his team.
